components.name: Search Field
components.description: The primary retrieval control, used once above the index.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-search::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--blue); content: ""; transform: scaleX(.08); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-search:focus-within::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-search-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; color: var(--blue-ink); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 38px 4px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 500 1.6rem/1.2 var(--font); letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-search:hover .ds-search-input { border-bottom-color: var(--blue); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--quiet); opacity: 1; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Clear Filters Button
components.description: A quiet text action shown beside the search field.
components.css: .ds-clear { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--blue-ink); font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--font); cursor: pointer; } .ds-clear:hover { border-bottom-width: 2px; } .ds-clear:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-clear:active { color: var(--blue); } .ds-clear:disabled { color: var(--quiet); cursor: default; opacity: .45; }

components.name: Subject Tab
components.description: A subject filter that becomes an auto-width horizontal tab on compact screens.
components.css: .ds-subject { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; width: 174px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--faint); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-subject::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--blue); content: ""; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-subject:hover::after, .ds-subject[aria-pressed="true"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-subject[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--blue-ink); font-weight: 700; } .ds-subject:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-subject-count { color: var(--quiet); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Article Index Row
components.description: The central archive record, optimized for title recognition before metadata.
components.html:
03

CSS Anchor Positioning, Hands On

A practical note from the standalone archive.

2026-07-29Guide · Laststance
components.css: .ds-article { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 18px; padding: 27px 0 29px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-article:hover, .ds-article:focus-within { border-color: var(--blue); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue-soft) 54%, transparent); } .ds-folio { padding-top: 3px; color: var(--blue-ink); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-article-title { max-width: 24ch; margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.45rem,2.4vw,2.25rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.08; } .ds-article-title a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-article-title a:hover { color: var(--blue-ink); } .ds-article-title a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-article-excerpt { max-width: 70ch; margin: 13px 0 0; color: var(--quiet); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-article-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; margin: 15px 0 0; color: var(--quiet); font-size: 12px; } .ds-article-meta time { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Pagination Cell
components.description: A connected page control for archives longer than five records.
components.css: .ds-page { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 13px/1 var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-page:hover, .ds-page[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--sheet); background: var(--blue); } .ds-page[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 700; } .ds-page:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-page:active { background: var(--blue-ink); } .ds-page:disabled { color: var(--quiet); background: transparent; cursor: default; opacity: .38; }

components.name: Publication Day
components.description: A calendar day that marks available writing and supports date filtering.
components.css: .ds-day { position: relative; width: 44px; aspect-ratio: 1; padding: 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--faint); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 11px/1 var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-day:hover { color: var(--blue-ink); background: var(--blue-soft); } .ds-day[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--sheet); background: var(--blue); font-weight: 700; } .ds-day:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-has-entry::after { position: absolute; right: 50%; bottom: 3px; width: 4px; height: 2px; background: var(--blue); content: ""; transform: translateX(50%); } .ds-day[aria-pressed="true"]::after { background: var(--sheet); }

components.name: Code Slip
components.description: An optional literal-code fragment attached to an article record.
components.css: .ds-code { display: block; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 5px 8px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--blue-ink); font: 400 12px/1.55 ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-code:hover { border-color: var(--blue); } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Laststance Archive feels like an open working notebook whose pages have been carefully indexed. The interface is quiet, compact, and practical: the owner should recognize a remembered phrase, subject, or date before any surrounding interface competes for attention.

The visual system uses graphite ink, mineral blue, ruled paper, and square editorial controls. It deliberately avoids rounded dashboard cards, decorative shadows, and ornamental labels so the committed article titles and metadata remain the primary material.
keyCharacteristics: Search-first retrieval on one open ruled sheet.
Mineral blue reserved for indexing and interactive states.
Square controls and hairline rules instead of floating cards.
One compact sans-serif hierarchy, with monospace reserved for code.
Date and publication cues remain secondary to article recognition.

rules.name: The Mineral Signal Rule
rules.body: Mineral blue marks indexing, navigation, selection, focus, or publication; it does not fill passive decoration.

rules.name: The Paper Before Panels Rule
rules.body: Preserve one continuous ruled canvas and separate regions with lines and spacing instead of card backgrounds.

rules.name: The One Working Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Source Sans 3 for every interface role and reserve monospace for literal code snippets.

rules.name: The Attached Surface Rule
rules.body: Every control and result belongs to the notebook page; use borders, ruling, and tonal state changes instead of floating elevation.

dos: Do lead with search and real article titles when the job is rediscovery.
Do use mineral blue for index markers and active, linked, focused, selected, or published meaning.
Do preserve 44px minimum interactive targets and visible two-pixel focus outlines.
Do keep the subjects rail horizontally scrollable with a visible continuation cue on compact screens.
Do preserve the light and dark semantic color roles and reduced-motion override.
donts: Don't turn archive regions or article rows into rounded cards.
Don't add shadows, decorative gradient fills, ornamental kickers, or decorative badges.
Don't introduce a second interface typeface; use monospace only for code.
Don't make the calendar visually stronger than search, subjects, or article titles.
Don't use icon glyphs where plain text or CSS geometry communicates the control more clearly.
